headline: As of 2026-10-12: 3,234,793 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 34 of 50 states, D+25.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 3,234,793 early/mail ballots cast so far across 34 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+25.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (519,970), Florida (502,613), Michigan (393,689).
